entries.title: Muse Ember, Claude Fable 5.2 and Drex Max
entries.summary: Meta's smallest Muse model joins the catalog (and is what stealth/crouton-alpha turned out to be), Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 lands at $8 / $40 per 1M tokens, and Nace AI's Drex Max v1.1 and Drex Max Finance cover multimodal decisions.

entries.title: Crouton Alpha disabled
entries.summary: Crouton Alpha was an early version of Meta's Muse Ember, its new smallest model designed for scalable agentic execution — built for high-volume agent work such as tool calls, coding subtasks, routing and very long documents. Use meta/muse-ember — requests that still use this id are routed there.
